description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance payable to Workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes a special allowance payable to workers based on the Cost of Living Index Number, issued under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter that sets compliance requirements for employers in the specified trade sector, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
